name: karmahose
title: karmahose
blurb: a persistent, public tally for anything at all: end a Bluesky post with "<name> +1" or "<name> -1" and it joins a running global score, watched live off the firehose. no signup, no target to register — any name, any phrase. idea from @shimmermathlabs.com, tagged in by @cee.wtf asking for it to run persistently and in the background.
